name: Collect results
description: Closes a 'For each' loop. Pick a mode: collect (gather into an array), sum (add numbers), first (first non-null), last.

params.name: mode
params.description: How to combine the per-iteration values.

enum.label: Collect
enum.description: Gather every iteration's value into an array.

enum.label: Sum
enum.description: Add the numeric values together (numbers only).

enum.label: First non-null
enum.description: Stop at the first iteration that produced a value.

enum.label: Last
enum.description: Use only the value from the final iteration.
